tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya'i gzhi thog pho brang chen mo'i mgon khang tshoms bar du rgyal zla'i tshes gcig la gtor 'dzugs 'don khrid snod bcud byin 'bebs bzhugs so// oṃ swa satwi/ dpal sa skya'i gzhi thog bla brang gi mgon khang thog snga gras tshoms bar du/ lcags sbrul lo dpal sa skya'i gdung rabs myur 'byon gyi ched rigs byed lha mo tshogs bdag 'dod pa'i rgyal po rnams kyis sku mi tshad tsam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gzungs gzhug rab gnas brgya tshar gyi mtha' rten pa bcas bzhengs te/ lo de'i rgyal zla nas ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar mchod gtor rgyun mi chad par 'bul rgyu'i thog ma lcags sbrul rgyal zla'i tshes gcig zla byar 'grub sbyor ma bsgrigs rang 'grig byung ba nas bzung da lta'i bar phal cher sa skya pa kun blo rang nyid dang lo kha shas gzhan gyi gtor spod bcas bgyis pa'i 'don cha'i rim par/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ zhes dang so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/

oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta'i bar dang / mthar rdo rje snying gar bzung dril bu rgyun dkrol dang / oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe ṭa/ pra tsa li ne/ prañdzā pa ra mi ta nā da swa bhā wa/ badz+ra dharmā hrī da ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod de/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /mchod pa rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ khu tshur kha sbyar gung mo gnyis brkyangs te rtse sbyar chu bzhi'i rgya/ khu tshur gyen 'thor me tog gi thur du blug pa bdug pa'i 'o/ /mthe bong gyen sgreng mar me'i ste/ /thal mo phyir bstan dri mchog gi /de nyid gyen bkan zhal zas so/ /se gol gtog pa rol mo'i sgra/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge'i khri pad nyi la bla ma 'od dpag med longs spyod rdzogs sku dmar po mnyam bzhag can gyi sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs bla ma dang sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa la bdag dang sems can rnams 'jigs dad snying rje gsum gyi sgo nas byang chub bar du skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pas ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞dam pa'i chos rnams la༞'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun rig byed lha mo'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed byas la/ rang skad cig gis ku ru kul+ler gsal ba'i thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dbu la bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥku ru kul+le bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ ku ru kul+le/ zhes gcig sngon 'gro'i/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ thal mo sbyar la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig

ces lan cig brjod/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes sngags brjod pas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po ring cha tshegs drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu 'phros pas 'phags pa rnams mchod/ sems can thams cad rje btsun ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis ut+pa la'i mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs shing / g.yas 'og mas khams gsum 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu dang / g.yon 'og mas ut+pa la'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs shing 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing lang tsho lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu dbu skra khams pa gyen du brdzes pa/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yon du bstan pa'i steng du zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i brla la g.yas pa'i brang bar gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu'i 'od kor gyis yongs su mdzes shing snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i ut+pa la dmar po'i lte bar nyi ma la hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rigs byed kyi phug nas rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas dang byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drangs la/ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas oṃ badz+rī bhā wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de la rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par bsam zhing thal mo sbyar la/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing / /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdungs/ /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pa'i/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces pas mchod/ yi ge sngags rnams rnam par spangs/ /sgra dang thig le sems kyang med/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /bdag med gzhan yang med pa nyid/ /ces pas bstod/ bdud rtsi snod dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha

nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang / bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ shar du bhūṃ las dri chen/ lhor āṃ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bhūṃ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor āṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so so rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon bskor gyis/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ri rī/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ g.yas bskor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar bas/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing skol ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song bas oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes dang / lag pa g.yon/ g.yas gnyis ka dang / gdan bzhi las/

lag pa gnyis ni bkan byas la/ /srin lag gnyis ni phan tshun dkri/ /gung mo dang ni mtheb rtse sbyar/ /khro bo gnyis kyis mnan par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blang ste myangs/ bde bas mnyes par bsam/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng gi bskor ba mar me'i phreng ba lta bu las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi stobs sogs kyi yon tan thams cad dang / skye 'gro bsod nams can rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang thang thams cad 'od zer kha dog dmar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim par bsam la/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswāhā/ zhes ma yengs par tsan+dan dmar po'i phreng ba mig med kyi steng nas drangs shing bgrang la phreng 'khor gcig gi mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ man ngag thob na rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa bsgoms pa ni/ lus gnad bcos te rlung ro bsal la/ rang nyid rje btsun ma ku ru kul+ler gsal ba'i lus kyi nang phru ma phus btab pa lta bu dmar seng nge ba'i dbus lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar la rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar ser/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po me'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar smug g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po chu'i rang bzhin kha dog dkar po ste gsum ka gro sog 'bring po tsam/ dbu ma la brten pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte ba dbu ma'i mas snar oṃ dmar po dbu can gyi shad lta bu'i klad kor dbu ma'i nang du chud pa me'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar ser mgo gyen du bstan pa/ nang 'khor 'dab ma brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha phyi bskor drug cu rtsa bzhi la/

mdun nas g.yon bskor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ rnams mgo gyen du bstan pa/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa rnams mgo gyen du bstan pa/ phyi nang gi yig 'bru thams cad kha dog dmar ser/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su hūm̐/ phyogs bzhir bhūṃ āṃḥdz+rīṃ khaṃ/ mtshams bzhir laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ rnams kha dog sngon po mgo thur du bstan pa/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i dbus su aṃ/ rtsa 'dab bcu drug la mdun nas g.yon bskor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ rnams kha dog dmar po mgo gyen du bstan pa/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbus dbu ma'i yas snar haṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa klad kor dbu ma'i nang du chud pa/ 'dab ma sum cu so gnyis la mdun nas g.yon bskor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ g.yas bskor du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta rnams kha dog dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi steng dbu ma'i nang du hrīḥdamar po mgo gyen du bstan pa/ bshang sgor rlung / sum mdor me/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor ba lan gsum byas mtha' ma la bsdams pas bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ sum mdo'i me sbar te lte ba'i aṃ la bsnun pas aṃ las me shin tu cha phra ba g.yas ro ma nas song / lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi yig 'bru rnams kyi khams snyigs bsregs/ yang ro ma nas song / snying ga'i yig 'bru rnams kyi khams snyigs bsregs/ hrīḥlas 'od dmar po 'phros pas/ g.yas kyi me dang lhan cig tu ro ma nas song /

mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi khams snyigs bsregs/ me ro ma'i yas sna nas 'thon/ thod pa'i nang du mdun nas g.yon bskor gyis rna ba g.yas pa'i bu ga nas song / phyag g.yas pa'i mda' stong sbyar ba'i mda'i stong nas bzhugs/ rim pas song ste/ mde'u ut+pa la dmar po kha bye nas 'od zer phyir song bas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems sems can thams cad ku ru kul+ler gsal ba'i rna ba g.yas pa nas zhugs/ spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba rnams kyi 'khor lo'i khams kyi dwangs ma rnams bsdus nas/ rna ba g.yas pa'i bu ga nas 'thon/ rang gi ut+pa la'i mde'u'i nang du zhugs/ rna ba g.yas pa nas song / ltag pa nas g.yas su bskor te/ spyi bo'i haṃ zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang 'grogs nas g.yon rkyang ma nas thur du babs pas/ mgrin pa dang snying ga'i 'khor lo rgyas par byas/ lte ba'i aṃ la thigs pa gcig phog pas me cher 'bar/ dbu ma'i mas sna kha bye nas/ dbu ma nas yar song / snying ga'i hūm̐ dang hrīḥ mgrin pa'i aṃ rnams kyi snyigs ma bsregs/ dbu ma'i yas sna kha bye ste/ spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas/ haṃ las byang sems dkar po babs pas/ mgrin pa dang snying ga'i yi ge gsum gsos btab/ lte ba'i gang sor bzhi tsam du 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad pas 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du 'dus/ zhes brjod cing gsal btab la/ rlung bum pa can ci thub bzung / mi thub na rlung dal bus btang zhing ngal gsos/ rlung btang ba'i tshe 'bar 'dzag la yid drag tu gtad cing / mthar byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsis gsang gnas yan chad du khyab cing gang ba la brten nas byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bzhi thob cing / yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi'i rtogs pa skyes te/ thabs shes gnyis su med pas ye shes dri ma med pa las byung ba'i dam pa'i bde ba bla na med pas rang gi lus dang snod bcud thams cad khyab par mos ste/ gang la thog ma dbus mtha' med/

/srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /bdag med gzhan yang yod ma yin/ /rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad kyis stong pa'i de bzhin nyid dang / 'khor 'das gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'i mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par snang tsam dbyer mi phyed pa'i bde stong dbyer med nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /zhes brjod cing gsal btab la/ shes pa khong lhod kyis klod nas mnyam par bzhag ldang bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim/ zhes brjod/ 'dir rje btsun ma'i sku bsgom zhing sngags bzlas pa ni bum dbang gi lam/ rtsa gsum dang 'khor lo bzhi gsal btab nas 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad pa ni gsang dbang gi lam/ bde ba'i nyams myong la sems gtad pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi lam/ gang la thog ma sogs kyi tshig don la mnyam par 'jog pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i lam yin no/ /mdun bskyed ni/ de nas sku/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod brgyad kyis/ zhes pa nas/ yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le/ zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ bar/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bar/ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol bar/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nas/ dbu brgyan bar bdag mdun tshig bsgyur mi 'dra ba de rnams ma gtogs gong bzhin no/ /mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad par bsam la/ dku g.yon par khu tshur gnyis steng 'og tu kha sbyar te/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ ku ru kul+le sa pa ri wā ra/

zhes dang rnam lnga 'dod skor sngon du 'gro bas zhabs bsil gyi phyag rgya dang / ni rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing se gol gtog de bzhin du tshigs bcad sngags kyi thog mtha' dang phyag rgya rnams 'dra ba las/ dri med yid du༞/lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan༞/bzhes nas༞/oṃ ku ru ni wi te hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ dri med yid du༞/lha rdzas dam pa'i 'thor 'thung 'di/ /bcom ldan༞/bzhes nas༞/oṃ ku ru༞sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ dri med yid du༞/lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan༞/bzhes nas༞/oṃ ku ru༞dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas chu bzhi dbul/ de bzhin du me tog la sogs pa so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ ku ru kul+le༞zhes sogs dang / puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams 'dra ba las/ tshal bdag ro ni phan pa dang / /gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /sogs gong bzhin las/ dhū pe/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed pa/ /dge shing mun pa rnam sel ba/ /ā lo ke 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /gan+de/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yid gar 'ong / /sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /nai wi d+ye/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di/ /bdag gi sogs nas/ shap+ta'i mthar dril bu rgyun dkrol du byas te/ gan+ḍe ra ṇi sogs brjod/ gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ zhes dang / srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/

/bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ ku ru༞zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra wasatrā ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i khu tshur gnyis kyis na bza' blangs te thog mar smad g.yogs dang / de nas stod g.yogs su 'bul ba'i tshul bya zhing / lha re re la phul bar bsam mo/ /de nas g.yon pa'i srin lag gis nang mchod nas blangs te mthe bong rtses gtor la lha thams cad kyi phyag tu thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re byung bar bsam zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' bsam 'grub kun dga' mtshan dpe'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le༞rgyal po lhan skyes rol pa/ rdo rje gdan pa mya ngan med pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ rgyal tshab chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar rlungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/

rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rje btsun ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshogs bdag gi brgyud pa/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje phag mo/ grub chen sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ri khrod mgon po/ haṃ ngu dkar po/ mal lo blo gros grags pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ rin po che skyobs pa dpal/ rong pa shes rab seng ge bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dod rgyal gyi brgyud pa/ dpal mchog rdo rje chos/ ḍā ki ma bde ba rgyas byed ma/ dze ta ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ grub chen la li ta badz+ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/

zhang ston bsod nams 'bum/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ gu ru shes rab bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ lo pa ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po/ sogs gong bzhin gyi mthar/ zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du༞oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswāhā/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i zhal du༞de nas rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas lus kyi lha rnams mchod par bsam/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wī ye/ dharmā pā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du༞gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyi bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi༞gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / tshan+dho dang nye ba'i tshan+dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i sku 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du༞zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/

pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du༞gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du༞gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du༞'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshims shing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rang gis kyang myang la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas dril bu sum brdung bya zhing / rang gi snying ga nas lha mo brgyad sprul te mchod par bsam la/ dkar mo ri dwags/ sogs dang / de rnams kyis bstod par bsam pa/ gdangs dang bcas pas/ brtse bas rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /mda' gzhu ut+pal dbang gi lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bcom ldan rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus bcom ldan ma/ /yid 'phrog pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs can ma/ /srid gsum dbang du sdud pa'i myos byed ma/ /rje btsun ma khyod snying nas dwang bas bstod/ /chu skyes lte bar dbugs bral snying gi rtser/ /nyin byed dkyil 'khor bzhad pa'i gdan steng na/ /byi ru'i smin legs nyams brgya'i rol rtsed mkhan/ /yid 'ong mig gi bdud rtsi e ma mtshar/ /zung gnyis phyag gi 'khri shing myu gu ni/ /khams gsum snying 'bigs mda' gzhu ut+pal dang / /lcags kyu zhags pa'i snang brnyan me tog phreng /

/skal bzang bung ba bsdu ba'i dri bsung g.yo/ /rab 'bar dbu rgyan thod skam nor bu'i mtshan/ /khrag gis sbags pa'i mgo phreng stag sham dang / /dung chen phreng bas spras pa'i sgeg mdzes sku/ /nyi gzhon 'bar ba'i 'od kyi gur khang bzhugs/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bdud chen brdzis/ spyan zur g.yo bas 'gro kun dbang du mdzad/ /'o 'dzin chu 'dzin bzhad pa'i skal ldan gyi/ /snying gi pad+mo g.yo ba'i rje btsun ma/ /khyed la dad pas bstod pas byin rlabs kyis/ /kun rdzob cir yang snang ba'i zlos gar 'di/ /rang sems dag pa'i dbyings su dbang byas te/ /bde chen ye shes rang zhal mthong bar shog /gnas skabs 'dir yang tshe dang bsod nams dang / /dpal 'byor legs tshogs dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shing / /mi dang mi min 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dbang du 'dus nas bde la 'god par shog /zhes sogs kyis bstod pa gang shes bya/ de nas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng gi zhes sogs sngags phreng gsal btab la/ rang la thim/ bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ sngags phreng 'khor gcig song ba dang / maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa zhes nyi zla zhags pa 'bul tshul rgyun bzhin la/ rje btsun rig byed lha mo la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad dbang du bsdu bar mdzad du gsol/ srab 'jam yang ba sogs gos zung / oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /me tog dmar po'i phreng ba rnams/ /rgyal yum nyid la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bras dmar po gtor/ yang sngags nas me tog dmar po 'thor ba'i bar tshar dgu byas pas/ sngags stong dang / maṇ+ḍal gos zung me tog rnams tshar bcur 'gyur/ gtor ma byin rlabs/

gong gi bdud rtsi bzhin gyi dmar po skor gsum ka'i gtor ma dus gcig la byin gyis brlabs/ rje btsun ma'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro btags pas phul/ oṃ ku ru kul+le oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ bar/ oṃ ku ru kul+le oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs/ brtse bas rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /mda' gzhu ut+pal dbang gi lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bcom ldan rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyis stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /de rnams rig byed ma'i skor ro/ /de nas/ rang rig byed lha mor gsal ba'i mdun du baiḍūr+ya'i brag ri'i khrod du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nor bdag byi ba sngon po rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i steng du gaḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dmar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ rno zhing dkar ba'i mche ba rab tu gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog nag po spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bus mtshan zhing / dar dmar po'i cod pan 'phur ba/

phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug na dgra satwa mda' can lcags kyu rdo rje ral gri 'phang mdung rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa drug na gtun shing gzhu kha ṭ+wāṃ ga khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa sha chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa phub dang lhan cig mdung la ba dan btags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi bzhi pa'i phyag mtshan rdo rje dang thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin zhing / lhag ma rnams 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis bzung ba/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol zhing / rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis 'od zer dmar po rab tu 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su gaḥyig dmar po de nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te mdun gyi tshogs kyi bdag po la thim par mos la dril bu gsil zhing / oṃ gaḥgaḥsid+dhi sid+dhi sarba ar+tha me pra sā dha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa mang du brjod pas bkug pa/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ mdun du bsgoms pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par mos te/ de la oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul nas/ sa ma ya ho/ zhes pas dam la bzhag slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha/ spyan drangs ba sogs gong bzhin byas nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyi dbur brgyan par mos la tshogs bdag gi mchod pa gong bzhin/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi/ sogs gong bzhin la/ mchod yon zhabs bsil/ sogs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ spro na/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /lha chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/

/bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ ga ṇa pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar la'ang 'don ba bsgyur ba'i mthar ḍā dril/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba'i nang mchod/ dril gsil/ 'jig rten mgon mdzad snang ba mdzad/ /dpal mdzad de bzhin phan pa mdzad/ /mnyam pa med cing dpe med pa/ /tshogs bdag de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags dbang phyug rig sngags rgyal/ /longs spyod 'byung gnas gter gyi mchog /'bras bu mngon par ston pa po/ /tshogs bdag de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po bdud las rgyal/ /stobs chen nyon mongs g.yul ngo 'joms/ /bgegs 'joms 'jig rten 'joms mdzad pa/ /glang chen snar ldan gtso la 'dud/ /rin chen chen po rin chen sku/ /rin chen chen po rin chen 'byung / /rin chen bstan pa srung mdzad pa/ /glang chen snar ldan gtso la 'dud/ /tshogs kyi bdag po rdzu 'phrul che/ /lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin zhing / /lha min nag po'i g.yul bzlog pa/ /glang chen snar ldan gtso la 'dud/ /sku ni yon tan rin chen te/ /gsung ni yon tan ngo bo nyid/ /thugs ni yon tan bdag nyid can/ /glang chen snar ldan khyod la 'dud/ /'di grub chen nag po spyod pas mdzad/ gzhan yang / rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ /tshogs rje tshogs dbang tshogs kyi bdag /bgegs kyi gtso la mchod cing bstod/ /me tog la sogs mchod pa dang / /la du la sogs mthun rdzas kyis/ /bgegs rgyal tshogs bdag 'khor bcas mchod/ /dngos grub thams cad bdag la stsol/ /'di gong mas mdzad/ gtor ma la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ mdzod rgya se gol/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/

lan gsum gyis bsngos/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod nang mchod/ dril gsil/ rgyal ba'i phrin las las sprul pas/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs kun bcom nas/ /sgrub la dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i/ /'dod dgu'i char 'bebs khyod la bstod/ /gang zhig sgrub par byed pa la/ /log par sgrub pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /mthong tsam du'ang mi 'gyur ba'i/ /tshogs kyi bdag po khyod la bstod/ /byi ru ltar dmar brjid pa'i sku/ /thogs med las grub rig sngags gsung / /bde chen gnyis med ye shes thugs/ /bde ba'i mchog gis sprul mdzad bstod/ /mchod yon me tog spos mar me/ /dri dang bza' bca' btung ba bgo /rgyan dang rol mo sna tshogs kyis/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /'di chos rje bla mas mdzad/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag pos mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad thams cad srung / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa 'khor dang longs spyod snyan grags legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / mdor na bsam pa'i don 'di dag thams cad chos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas yid bzhin du 'grub cing / khyad par brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad bdag gi dbang du bsdus nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig ces 'dod don zhus/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros pa mdun gyi tshogs bdag gi thugs ka'i gaḥyig sngags kyis bskor ba la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas skye 'gro dbang du bsdus shing zas nor gyi char dbab nas dngos grub thams cad bstsal bar bsam zhing /

oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ brgya phrag la sogs pa'i 'go drangs pa'i/ oṃ āḥgaḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ wa ra ka tā ya swāhā/ oṃ wa ka te ka daṃ ṣ+ṭa bin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ bhūṃ ga ṇa pa ta ye swāhā/ spro na gzungs kyang bzlas ste/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ na mo stu te ma hā ga ṇa pa ta ye/ oṃ gaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥ oṃ ga ṇa pa ta ye swāhā/ oṃ ga ṇa dhī pa ta ye swāhā/ oṃ ga ne shwa rā ya swāhā/ oṃ ga ṇa pa te pū dzi ta swāhā/ oṃ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma da ma da/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ ha na ha na/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ dhā wa dhā wa/ bhañdza bhañdza/ stam+bha stam+bha/ mo ha mo ha/ de hi de hi/ da da pā ya/ da da pā ya/ dha na sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha na mo stu te ma hā ru tra pa tsā nā ya swāhā/ oṃ āḥbhu ta bhan dhu k+ṣu ba ta ra tu ma hā swāhā/ sa mā gats+tshan+ta te/ na maḥ.a mṛ ta/ bin dhu k+ṣu ta/ tsit+ta ma hā sa ma/ gats+tshi ti ma hā/ bha ya ma hā/ bā la pra kra ma/ ma hā ha ti/ pra bho da dā mi swāhā/ oṃ na mo stu ti ma hā ga ṇa pa ta ye swāhā/ oṃ gaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥg ṇa pa ta ye swāhā/ oṃ ga ṇa dhī pa ta ye swāhā/ oṃ ga ne shwa ra ye swāhā/ oṃ ga ṇa pa te pū dzi ta ye swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ mu ru mu ru swāhā/ oṃ na mo na ma swāhā/ oṃ na mo stu te ma hā ga ṇa pa ta ye swāhā/ mā ma sa pa ri wa ra s+ya sarba satwa nan tsa sarba bigh+nān bi na ya ka ni shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ sum+bha ni dang sngags thung rnams phreng 'khor sngags ring nyer gcig bzlas pa'i mthar/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag pos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ sogs gong bzhin 'dod gsol bya/ mchod rdzas rnams 'dod yon lngar dmigs la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin zhing gdangs dang bcas pas/ me tog phreng ba la sogs rin chen dbyig

/la du la phug 'bras bu yid 'ong zas/ /phyogs bcu'i chu skyes thang skyes longs spyod rkyen/ /ris ma bcad pa'i mchod sprin rgyas par 'bul/ /maṇ+ḍal dam pa rab tu mdzes pa dang / /bshos gtsang mar me yon chab sna tshogs dang / /'bras chang rgun chang la sogs btung ba'i mchog /sbrang rtsi bu ram la sogs mngar ba'i ro/ /lhan cig skyes dang rab tu sbyar ba yi/ /sna tshogs mchod pa dam pa 'di dag bzhes/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i rnam 'phrul las/ /byung ba'i bla med mchod pa 'di dag 'bul/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg sogs kun ldan pa'i/ /'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /bdag nyid dwang bas bsham shing sprul pa yi/ /mchod pa'i tshogs kyis lha chen mnyes gyur cig /de rnams tshogs bdag gi skor ro/ /de nas 'dod rgyal gyi sku/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhūṃ dmar po las byung ba'i rin po che pad+ma rā ga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang zla gam sgo gcig pa/ rin po che'i pha gu dang / drwa ba dang / drwa ba phyed pa dang / mda' yab dang pu shu la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ steng thog rim par phub pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo'i mdun du rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang ri dwags la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig dmar po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ snod bcud thams cad dbang du bsdus nas 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par tshur 'dus te hūm̐ yig la thim/

de 'od du zhu ba las khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar 'od 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu 'phyar thabs su 'dzin cing / g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang / dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ de'i pang du yum bde ba rgyas byed ma sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar stabs su 'dzin cing / g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pas yab la khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis yab la 'khril ba/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang / dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yab kyi thugs kar hūm̐ yig dmar po'i mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kha dog dmar pos g.yon skor du bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bde ba can nas khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong ltar mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan/
